Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the establishment of a master hunter program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a master hunter program; and adding a newsection to chapter 77.32 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature intends to establish a master hunter program toencourage and enhance hunter/landowner relations. The master hunterprogram's purpose is to assist the department in effectively managingwildlife in areas and at times when both a high ethical standard and ademonstrated skill level are needed for resource protection and publicsafety. Individuals certified by the department to participate in themaster hunter program may assist the department and private landownerswith issues such as wildlife conservation, habitat protection, andwildlife damage. (2) The commission shall adopt rules for the administration of themaster hunter program in order to avoid potential fraud and abuse. Noperson may qualify for the master hunter program under this sectionwithout first undergoing a criminal background check. p. 1 HB 3194 (3) Persons who meet and maintain the master hunter programrequirements may participate in special hunts or animal removals underchapters 77.12 and 77.36 RCW.
